definitions.explanation: A store that sells goods directly to individual consumers, as opposed to a wholesaler that sells in bulk to businesses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小売店|こうりてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy at a retail store in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小売店|こうりてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}されて→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Local retail shops are declining under pressure from large supermarkets.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{小売店|こうりてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}けられる→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: This product reaches consumers from the manufacturer through retail stores.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧ (retail) + ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop/store). Refers to any store that sells directly to end consumers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小売店|こうりてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧: to run a retail store
- {小売店|こうりてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sell at a retail store
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧{小売店|こうりてん}: independent retail shop
- {小売店|こうりてん}{向|む}け: aimed at retail stores

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{卸売店|おろしうりてん}→卸売店：24113_oroshiuriten⟧: wholesale store — sells in bulk to businesses rather than individual consumers
- ⟦{専門店|せんもんてん}→専門店：15924_senmonten⟧: specialty store — a retail store focused on a specific category
- ⟦{量販店|りょうはんてん}→量販店：20498_ryouhanten⟧: mass retailer — a large-scale store selling in high volume at low prices
- ⟦{商店|しょうてん}→商店：11841_shouten⟧: shop, store — a general term, often referring to smaller or traditional shops

USAGE:
Japan's retail landscape has shifted significantly, with many traditional {小売店|こうりてん} in ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧ (shopping streets) giving way to convenience stores, large chain stores, and online shopping.
